caption: The drawing depicts a cushion with an embroidered floral design. The cushion itself is primarily dark green with some lighter yellow-green highlights at its edges. The central embroidery consists of a cluster of flowers and leaves; most prominent are a red rose, a purple flower, and a light pink flower with yellow in the center, all surrounded by smaller white blossoms and various green leaves. The colors in the embroidery are vivid, with gradients of green in the leaves, shades of purple, pink, and red in the flowers, and touches of yellow and white among the blossoms and leaf veins. The cushion has a textured, slightly irregular rectangular shape, and the impression of needlepoint or cross-stitch technique is visible. The artist’s name, Edith Maguette, is written in small letters at the bottom left of the image.
title: Pillow Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
